Hello dear all, I have some question about GOF. I am reading Kery and Royle book on HIrarchical modeling in ecology. In chapter 8, related to the HDS models the authors said: "The bootstrap analysis shows that the model does not fit at all, with not a single bootstrap sample falling to the right of the observed value, for any of the three fit statistics. That is, under the Null hypothesis of a fitting model, we don’t expect to see any more extreme values of the fit statistics than their value for the observed data set..."

So what I need to do is to accept the null hipotesis that says: the model explains your abundance and detection. Is this correct?

Thank you very much in advance
Antonela
